en.multiphysics.mesh_study_hint: Is the answer the grid's or the design's? Two copies of this study on coarser grids, run with it, show how far each part's temperature still moves with the grid.
en.multiphysics.mesh_study_made: Made: {cells} cells, fine to coarse. Run all three studies.

en.multiphysics.mesh_study_units: Settled: the grid-independent temperature the three grids point to. Grid index: the band, as a share of the fine grid's rise above the inflow, it is expected in; under 5 % is settled enough for most designs.
